claims: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's SLS rocket in deep space.
Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
Artemis II sends four astronauts including the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit on a journey around the Moon.
Artemis II sends four astronauts including the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit on a journey around the Moon.
Artemis II sends four astronauts including the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit on a journey around the Moon.
The Artemis II journey around the Moon passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond it.
Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for the Artemis III, IV, and future missions.
The Artemis III, IV, and future missions will land humans back on the lunar surface.
The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen.
